title: Design System: Corretor Studio
source: Scan mode — extracted from DESIGN.md token blocks + app/globals.css + shadcn/ui components. Root DESIGN.md unchanged (feeds design:sync).

display.purpose: Hero headlines and landing section titles. Poppins 700–800, tight tracking (≥ -0.04em floor).

headline.purpose: Section headings in app and marketing. Poppins 700, 36–48px.

title.purpose: Card titles and dialog headers. Poppins/Inter 600, 24px.

body.purpose: Prose and descriptions. Inter 400, 16px, line-height 1.6, max 65–75ch.

label.purpose: UI actions, form labels, table headers. Inter 500–600, 14px.

shadows.name: precision-1
shadows.purpose: Subtle elevation for data panels and technical cards.

shadows.name: precision-2
shadows.purpose: Featured cards and highlighted integration blocks.

shadows.name: precision-3
shadows.purpose: Hero floating badges and premium showcase moments only.

shadows.name: card-ambient
shadows.purpose: Landing feature bento cards at rest.

motion.name: duration-base
motion.purpose: Standard state transitions in app UI.

motion.name: ease-entrance
motion.purpose: Scroll-triggered reveals; run once per viewport entry.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: Default app CTA — orange fill, compact radius, focus ring.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 8px; height: 36px; padding: 0 16px; border: none; border-radius: calc(var(--radius) - 2px); background: var(--primary); color: var(--primary-foreground); font-family: Inter, system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 14px; font-weight: 500; line-height: 1.4; cursor: pointer; transition: background 150ms cubic-bezier(0.2, 0, 0, 1); outline: none; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: color-mix(in oklab, var(--primary) 90%, black); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { border-color: var(--ring); box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px color-mix(in oklab, var(--ring) 50%, transparent); } .ds-btn-primary:disabled { opacity: 0.5; pointer-events: none; }

components.name: Secondary Button
components.description: Neutral outlined action for secondary flows.
components.css: .ds-btn-secondary { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 8px; height: 36px; padding: 0 16px; border: 1px solid var(--border); border-radius: calc(var(--radius) - 2px); background: var(--background); color: var(--foreground); font-family: Inter, system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 14px; font-weight: 500; box-shadow: 0 1px 2px rgba(0,0,0,0.05); cursor: pointer; transition: background 150ms cubic-bezier(0.2, 0, 0, 1); outline: none; } .ds-btn-secondary:hover { background: var(--accent); color: var(--accent-foreground); } .ds-btn-secondary:focus-visible { border-color: var(--ring); box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px color-mix(in oklab, var(--ring) 50%, transparent); }

components.name: Ghost Button
components.css: .ds-btn-ghost { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 8px; height: 36px; padding: 0 16px; border: none; border-radius: calc(var(--radius) - 2px); background: transparent; color: var(--foreground); font-family: Inter, system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 14px; font-weight: 500; cursor: pointer; transition: background 150ms cubic-bezier(0.2, 0, 0, 1); outline: none; } .ds-btn-ghost:hover { background: var(--accent); color: var(--accent-foreground); } .ds-btn-ghost:focus-visible { box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px color-mix(in oklab, var(--ring) 50%, transparent); }

components.name: Landing Pill CTA
components.description: Conversion CTA for hero, pricing, checkout hotspots only. Larger radius and orange glow.
components.css: .ds-btn-pill-cta { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 8px; padding: 14px 24px; border: none; border-radius: 1rem; background: var(--primary); color: var(--primary-foreground); font-family: Poppins, Inter, system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 16px; font-weight: 600; text-decoration: none; box-shadow: 0 12px 28px -8px color-mix(in oklab, var(--primary) 60%, transparent); cursor: pointer; transition: transform 220ms cubic-bezier(0.2, 0, 0, 1), background 150ms cubic-bezier(0.2, 0, 0, 1); outline: none; } .ds-btn-pill-cta:hover { transform: scale(1.02); background: color-mix(in oklab, var(--primary) 92%, black); } .ds-btn-pill-cta:focus-visible { box-shadow: 0 0 0 2px var(--ring), 0 12px 28px -8px color-mix(in oklab, var(--primary) 60%, transparent); }

components.name: Text Input
components.description: Border-first form control with ring focus.
components.css: .ds-input { display: flex; width: 100%; height: 36px; padding: 4px 12px; border: 1px solid var(--input); border-radius: calc(var(--radius) - 2px); background: transparent; color: var(--foreground); font-family: Inter, system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 14px; line-height: 1.4; box-shadow: 0 1px 2px rgba(0,0,0,0.04); transition: border-color 150ms, box-shadow 150ms; outline: none; } .ds-input::placeholder { color: var(--muted-foreground); } .ds-input:focus-visible { border-color: var(--ring); box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px color-mix(in oklab, var(--ring) 50%, transparent); } .ds-input:disabled { opacity: 0.5; cursor: not-allowed; }

components.css: .ds-card-feature { position: relative; padding: 32px; border: 1px solid var(--border); border-radius: 1rem; background: color-mix(in oklab, var(--card) 85%, transparent); box-shadow: 0 20px 40px -20px color-mix(in oklab, var(--primary) 22%, transparent); backdrop-filter: blur(8px); -webkit-backdrop-filter: blur(8px); transition: transform 220ms cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1), box-shadow 220ms; } .ds-card-feature:hover { transform: translateY(-2px); box-shadow: 0 24px 48px -20px color-mix(in oklab, var(--primary) 28%, transparent); border-color: color-mix(in oklab, var(--primary) 30%, var(--border)); } .ds-card-feature-icon { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; width: 56px; height: 56px; margin-bottom: 20px; border-radius: 0.75rem; background: color-mix(in oklab, var(--primary) 15%, transparent); color: var(--primary); } .ds-card-feature-title { margin: 0 0 12px; font-family: Poppins, Inter, sans-serif; font-size: 24px; font-weight: 600; line-height: 1.3; color: var(--foreground); } .ds-card-feature-body { margin: 0; font-family: Inter, sans-serif; font-size: 16px; line-height: 1.6; color: var(--muted-foreground); }

narrative.overview:
Corretor Studio combines Zapier's warm conversion energy with Stripe-grade hierarchy and Linear's luminance discipline. Orange carries conversion moments; precision indigo and semantic tokens handle data and status. The system rejects generic SaaS scaffolding and legacy CRM grayness — every surface either sells advantage (landing) or accelerates the next commercial action (app).

Density is intentional in operational flows: kanban, tables, and dashboards show rich information without flat spreadsheet aesthetics. Landing uses bento asymmetry and cinematic proof sections; the app uses border-first depth and skeleton loading states.

Light and dark themes share the same token vocabulary. Motion is short, purposeful, and respects prefers-reduced-motion.
keyCharacteristics: Primary orange (#ff6900) for CTAs and conversion hotspots only
Poppins display + Inter body/UI typography pairing
Surface ladder (--surface-0 through --surface-4) for luminance depth
Semantic status pairs (success, warning, danger, info, new) with tinted badge pattern
Border-first cards in app; chromatic ambient shadows on landing feature cards
Motion: 150–320ms, ease-out exponential, no looping gimmicks

rules.name: The Conversion Accent Rule
rules.body: Orange appears on primary actions, active selection, and landing conversion blocks. It never fills large background areas.

rules.name: The Gradient Word Rule
rules.body: Gradient text (landing-primary-gradient) is limited to highlighted words in headlines — never full sentences or body copy.

rules.name: The Tracking Floor Rule
rules.body: Display headlines use letter-spacing ≥ -0.04em. Tighter values make letters touch and read as cramped.

rules.name: The Flat-By-Default Rule
rules.body: Dense data areas use border-only depth. Chromatic shadows are reserved for premium CTAs and highlighted landing cards.

rules.name: The State Motion Rule
rules.body: Motion conveys state change and feedback — not decoration. No orchestrated page-load sequences in product UI.

rules.name: The Two Accent Rule
rules.body: Do not mix more than two accent families in one component. Orange + one precision or semantic accent maximum.

dos: Do use semantic CSS tokens (var(--primary), var(--surface-2), var(--semantic-success)) — never hardcoded hex in JSX/TSX.
Do use shadcn/ui primitives (Button, Card, Input, Badge) before custom markup.
Do maintain 44×44px minimum touch targets on mobile.
Do show visible focus rings on all interactive controls.
Do use Skeleton for loading states in app UI.
Do keep hero headline contract: 'Corretores comuns mandam cotações. Os de ALTA PERFORMANCE usam Corretor Studio.'
Do run bun run design:check after token changes to DESIGN.md.
donts: Don't use SaaS genérico (AI slop): identical card grids with icon + title + text, hero-metric templates, cream/sand body backgrounds, eyebrows on every section, decorative gradient text, glassmorphism as default.
Don't use CRM legado aesthetics: dense gray tables, flat hierarchy, 2010-era corporate dividers, spreadsheet feel.
Don't use startup barulhenta patterns: looping animations, competing multi-accent noise, hype without operational substance.
Don't pair 1px border with wide soft drop shadows (ghost-card pattern) on the same element.
Don't use border-radius above 16px on cards (rounded-3xl is a codex tell). Pills are fine for tags and CTAs.
Don't use side-stripe borders (border-left/right > 1px) as colored accents on cards or alerts.
Don't manually edit TOKENS:* regions in app/globals.css — run bun run design:sync instead.
